body: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02700-4 Across five randomized trials in India, Kenya, Nepal, the Philippines and Uganda, weekly 20-minute mobile-phone-call tutorials produced large learning gains for primary-school children during school closures caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.
